convert_version_to_digits: convert a version string like 1.2.3a0 into a tuple of integers for comparison
compare_versions_with_digit_version: compare two version strings by converting them to digit tuples using digit_version
get_git_commit_hash: get the git commit hash of the current repository with optional digit truncation
get_short_git_hash: get a shortened git commit hash by specifying the number of digits to keep
run_command_with_minimal_env: run a shell command with a minimal environment using _minimal_ext_cmd
